data.title: Gabriel Valenzuela
data.bio: Gabriel Valenzuela grew up in the low desert, now based in Yucca Valley. Drummer + tape enthusiast + Saskia's dad. Promises more mixes are coming.
data.showDescription: You have now entered the queue, welcome to the waiting room.

shows.description: Gabriel Valenzuela's first all-vinyl bedroom mix recorded at Lodi Dottie's Flamingo Heights trailer. ♫ Ambient, Experimental, Electronic ♫
